entities.name: Query aminoacylase-1
observations: 407 aa protein; exact full-length sequence match to curated Sus scrofa aminoacylase-1 UniProt P37111.
Belongs to the M28/M20 metallopeptidase family with Peptidase_M28, Peptidase_M20, and M20_dimer domains.
Predicted to be a soluble, acidic protein of approximately 45.35 kDa with pI 5.61.

entities.name: Aminoacylase-1 P37111
observations: Curated aminoacylase involved in hydrolysis of N-acetylated and N-formylated amino acids.
Binds two Zn2+ ions per subunit.
EC 3.5.1.14; reported as a homodimer and cytoplasmic enzyme.
Reference active-site positions include 82 and 147; metal/substrate-binding features include positions 80, 113, 148, 175, and 372.

entities.name: N-acyl-L-amino acid hydrolysis
observations: Reaction: an N-acyl-L-amino acid + H2O = an L-alpha-amino acid + a carboxylate.

entities.name: N-acetyl-L-methionine hydrolysis
observations: Reaction: N-acetyl-L-methionine + H2O = L-methionine + acetate; Rhea RHEA:67440.
This is a representative substrate reaction, not proof that it is the only physiological substrate.

entities.name: N-formyl-L-methionine hydrolysis
observations: Reaction: N(alpha)-formyl-L-methionine + H2O = formate + L-methionine; Rhea RHEA:17781.
This supports formylamino-acid deformylase activity in addition to deacetylation.

entities.name: Zinc ion
observations: Aminoacylase-1 binds two Zn2+ ions per subunit in its catalytic metallohydrolase center.
